summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement suspending its at-the-market equity program and terminating the continuous offering under the August 24, 2026 ATM prospectus supplement, effective September 23, 2026. The ATM permitted sales of up to $50,000,000 of common shares through sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners; only $1,388,827.04 had been sold. Shares trade on Nasdaq under GRML, last at $14.15 on September 22, 2026. No further sales will occur unless a new prospectus supplement is filed; the sales agreement remains in force. This is a routine shelf/ATM administrative action, not a special situation.
